# expo-secure-enclave

> Hardware-backed ECDSA P-256 signing for Expo and React Native. Keys are generated in the iOS Secure Enclave or the Android Keystore (StrongBox-backed where available) and never leave it. Every signature requires a fresh Face ID, Touch ID, or fingerprint check, with no device-passcode fallback. Public keys are base64 X9.63 points (65 bytes); signatures are base64 DER ECDSA/SHA-256, identical on iOS and Android. Version 0.2.0, tested with Expo SDK 57; needs a development build (not Expo Go).

Good fit: device binding, passwordless challenge-response sign-in, approving payments or other sensitive actions, signing API requests or ES256 JWTs with a device-bound key that a server verifies.

Not a fit: storing secrets or tokens (use expo-secure-store), a local "confirm it's you" gate with no server (use expo-local-authentication), app or device attestation (App Attest, Play Integrity, Android key attestation: e.g. react-native-secure-enclave-operations), RSA keys, encryption, or signing without a biometric prompt.

Essentials:

- Install: `npx expo install expo-secure-enclave`, add `"expo-secure-enclave"` to `plugins` in app.json (optional `{ "faceIdUsageDescription": "..." }`), then rebuild the native app.
- API (all named exports): `isAvailable(): Promise<boolean>`, `hasKey(alias?)`, `getOrCreatePublicKey(alias?): Promise<string>`, `sign(message: string | Uint8Array, alias?): Promise<string>`, `deleteKey(alias?)`, `verify(publicKey, message, signature): boolean`, `SecureEnclaveError` with `reason`. `alias` defaults to `"default"`.
- Only `sign()` prompts. Every rejection is a `SecureEnclaveError` whose `reason` is `'cancelled' | 'biometric_failed' | 'key_invalidated' | 'unavailable'`; only `sign()` can produce the first three. `isAvailable()` is `false` exactly when creating a key or signing would be `unavailable` (including iOS Simulator, web, Expo Go).
- `key_invalidated` (biometrics changed, or no key): `deleteKey()`, `getOrCreatePublicKey()`, and register the new public key after the user authenticates another way.
- Server: verify DER ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256 over the exact bytes signed (strings are UTF-8), and accept high-S signatures. SPKI DER = hex `3059301306072a8648ce3d020106082a8648ce3d030107034200` + the 65-byte point.
- Jest: `jest.mock('expo-secure-enclave', () => require('expo-secure-enclave/mock'))`; `mockControls` simulates cancel, failure, invalidation, unavailability.
- Status: iOS core flow (create key, sign, verify) tested on a physical iPhone with 0.1.0; 0.2.0 changes built but not re-tested on a device. Android: compiles and the example app builds; not yet verified on a physical device.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/umar-tariq-1/expo-secure-enclave/main/docs/getting-started.md): requirements, installation for Expo and bare React Native, and a complete quick start
- [API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/umar-tariq-1/expo-secure-enclave/main/docs/api.md): every function, the four error reasons and how each platform maps to them, key and signature formats
- [Recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/umar-tariq-1/expo-secure-enclave/main/docs/recipes.md): device registration, passwordless sign-in, transaction approval, handling key invalidation, fallbacks, multiple keys, ES256 JWTs, with matching server code
- [Server-side verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/umar-tariq-1/expo-secure-enclave/main/docs/server-verification.md): Node.js, Web Crypto, jose, Python, Go, Java, OpenSSL, format conversions, test vectors
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/umar-tariq-1/expo-secure-enclave/main/docs/testing.md): the Jest mock, and Jest configuration for importing the real package
- [Security model](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/umar-tariq-1/expo-secure-enclave/main/docs/security-model.md): guarantees, limitations, key lifecycle, server responsibilities
- [Troubleshooting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/umar-tariq-1/expo-secure-enclave/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): common errors and fixes
- [Complete reference in one file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/umar-tariq-1/expo-secure-enclave/main/llms-full.txt): all of the above
